question: Under the laws of which country or territory is Blue Eagle and LBC Service Ltd., which LBC Express agreed to sell, organized?

docs.title: AEV: Material Information/Transactions
docs.text:
Malaysian Competition Commission Decision involving Gold Coin Feedmills (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd.

Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc. (AEV) received notice today from Gold Coin Feedmills (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. ("GCFM"), its indirect subsidiary, that it received written notice relating to the financial penalty imposed by Malaysia Competition Commission (MyCC) in the amount of RM 97,511,670.48 on GCFM for allegedly colluding with other feed millers in Malaysia to increase the poultry feed price during three periods between 2020 to 2022.GCFM disagrees with the findings and maintains that its pricing practices were independent, commercially justified, and compliant with applicable competition laws. GCFM has commenced judicial review proceedings before the High Court of Malaya, and an ad interim stay has been granted, suspending enforcement. Accordingly, the decision is on appeal and not yet enforceable.The MyCC decision has no material adverse impact on AEV’s financial position.

docs.title: LBC: Acquisition or Disposition of Shares of Another Corporation
docs.text:
Disposition of Shares in Blue Eagle and LBC Service Ltd.

On 22 April 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company approved the sale of all of the Company’s shares (the “Shares”) in Blue Eagle and LBC Service Ltd. (“Blue Eagle”), which Shares represent 100% ownership in Blue Eagle.

The divestment of Blue Eagle is pursuant to the plans of the Company to refocus strategic direction for Blue Eagle, which may include implementing certain organizational changes, with a view of turning around losses of the subsidiary.

The Company will execute a deed of sale of shares, which will be subject to the approval of the concerned regulator/s in the Republic of China (Taiwan).

Blue Eagle is a corporation organized under the laws of Republic of China (Taiwan) which is engaged in employment services.

NTD (New Taiwan Dollar) 2,000,000

The consideration is based on fair market value.

The full consideration is payable immediately upon signing of the relevant sale agreement.

Payment of the purchase price and approval of the concerned regulatory agency of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

The Company is optimistic that such organizational changes will benefit both the Company and Blue Eagle.
